summary.name: DataRobot AI Platform
summary.one_liner: DataRobot's Enterprise AI Suite is a platform for developing, delivering, and governing AI solutions across teams from data scientists to IT.
use_cases: deploy AI models for business use
unify data science and engineering workflows
run AI infrastructure on-premise or in the cloud
build AI apps teams use daily
summary.what_it_does: The page presents DataRobot's Enterprise AI Suite as a single AI platform for developing, delivering, and governing AI solutions. It lists role-based tools aimed at AI operators, ML and AI engineers, DevOps, IT and infosec, data scientists, data analysts, and software developers. It states that AI infrastructure can run on-premise, in a virtual private cloud, or as software as a service. The page offers a "Try for free" option and a guided product tour, but names no specific features beyond these.
notable: Deployment choice: on-premise, VPC, or SaaS
Role-based tools for data scientists through IT and infosec
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; specific features and pricing tiers are not described
The URL algorithmia.com and the awesome-ai-tools listing name Algorithmia, but the page content is DataRobot, so the listing may be outdated or mismatched
